about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Mark B. Messmer

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO FUNDS FOR REPEAT CHILD CARE VIOLATIONS ACT OF 2026
statements.title: NO FUNDS FOR REPEAT CHILD CARE VIOLATIONS ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of the Stop Child Care Scams Act, which provides a commonsense path toward preventing the rampant waste, fraud, and abuse in our Federal childcare support programs.
Every year, nearly 2 million children receive State and Federal Child Care and Development Block Grant subsidies totaling over $8 billion.

These childcare assistance programs allow lower income parents to stay in the workforce so they can create their own economic independence and contribute to the economic development in their communities.
Mistakes are not unusual given the changing nature of childcare, but because there is no penalty, the reporting of fraudulent payments is often ignored.
That is why I am pleased that my Child Care Payment Integrity and Fraud Accountability Act is included in today's bill.
I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PARENTAL RIGHTS OVER THE EDUCATION AND CARE OF THEIR KIDS ACT
statements.title: PARENTAL RIGHTS OVER THE EDUCATION AND CARE OF THEIR KIDS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 2616, the Stopping Indoctrination and Protecting Kids Act.

The Stopping Indoctrination and Protecting Kids legislation takes an important step in restoring any trust that has been broken by ensuring that parents are notified and involved in important school-based decisions affecting their children.
Mr. Speaker, for the sake of parental rights of Hoosiers in Indiana and the rights of schoolchildren across this great country, I urge my colleagues to support this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONWIDE CONSUMER AND FUEL RETAILER CHOICE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: NATIONWIDE CONSUMER AND FUEL RETAILER CHOICE ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to join me in investing in America's farm families, in agricultural businesses, and in our beloved rural communities by supporting this important legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FARM, FOOD, AND NATIONAL SECURITY ACT OF 2026
statements.title: FARM, FOOD, AND NATIONAL SECURITY ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Chair, I urge my colleagues to join me in supporting American farmers by voting in favor of this American farm bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MARCH FOR LIFE
statements.title: MARCH FOR LIFE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to speak about something very important to me, my family, and the majority of Hoosiers in Indiana's Eighth District: the protection of the unborn and the 2026 March for Life.

As a devout Catholic, I am grateful that from my position in Congress, I can support legislation that protects the defenseless unborn and can stand up for their God-given right to survive, a gift that truly should only be endowed upon any of us by the grace of our creator.

In my role in the House of Representatives, I am a reliable vote for the pro-life community and have been able to sponsor many pieces of legislation that provide for the needs of pregnant mothers and the life they are carrying in the womb.
I am honored to celebrate each person participating in this year's march, and I am grateful to be in the position to support the hopes of every Hoosier and American devoted to the sanctity of life.
It is my great privilege and fervent promise that I will never give up fighting for those who cannot fight for themselves. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EMPOWERING EMPLOYER CHILD AND ELDER CARE SOLUTIONS ACT
statements.title: EMPOWERING EMPLOYER CHILD AND ELDER CARE SOLUTIONS ACT
sentences: Current law discourages employers from helping their workers pay for onsite childcare or elderly dependent care because of the unreasonable pay calculations that increase costs and burdensome regulations for the company.
That is why I introduced the Empowering Employer Child and Elder Care Solutions Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING WORKING FAMILIES TAX CUTS
statements.title: SUPPORTING WORKING FAMILIES TAX CUTS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to celebrate the massive benefits that my constituents in Indiana and all Americans will reap thanks to the passage of the working families tax cuts.
Thanks to the death tax exemption, Hoosier farmers can pass their family-owned farms down to their children without losing most of it to the IRS.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIGITAL ASSET MARKET CLARITY ACT OF 2025
statements.title: DIGITAL ASSET MARKET CLARITY ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the CLARITY Act.
America's innovative ecosystem has made our Nation an investment magnet and development hub, but thus far, our regulatory system has failed the digital assets industry.

The CLARITY Act finally establishes distinct jurisdictional boundaries between the Securities and Exchange Commission and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, while also creating guardrails to incentivize and safeguard investment.
The digital asset markets are in dire need of regulation, and the CLARITY Act is the solution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 4, the Rescissions Act of 2025.
For decades, Americans have been waiting for their leadership to deliver on the promise that fiscal responsibility was on its way.
Wasteful spending of taxpayer dollars has been overlooked for far too long.
I am proud to vote today to make this first initial step to eliminate wasteful government spending.
By passing the Rescissions Act today, I join my colleagues in showing Americans that we hear them and we know that this change must be made.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEFENDING EDUCATION TRANSPARENCY AND ENDING ROGUE REGIMES ENGAGING IN NEFARIOUS TRANSACTIONS ACT
statements.title: DEFENDING EDUCATION TRANSPARENCY AND ENDING ROGUE REGIMES ENGAGING IN NEFARIOUS TRANSACTIONS ACT
sentences: For decades, the Chinese Communist Party, Iran, and Russia have targeted America's college systems by pushing dangerous propaganda aimed at influencing impressionable students.
Mr. Chair, I rise today in support of the DETERRENT Act.
I urge my colleagues to pass this bill, not just because it makes sense, but because it will put our adversaries on notice that we are watching them.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the Protecting Women and Girls in Sports Act and would like to clarify a comment from the gentleman on the other side of the aisle that as majority leader of the Indiana Senate, we easily overrode the Governor's veto of our State law protecting women in sports.
As a father and a grandfather, I am entirely against forcing anybody's daughter or granddaughter to have to share a women's locker room with anyone other than women and girls.
Title IX was created to protect equality and opportunity for women and girls in sports.
Thanks to this legislation, we will go back to doing just that.
